Mr. President @realDonaldTrump,
instead of taking Iran back to the Stone Age, target these Stone Age–mindset men who are hanging protesters in the middle of a war for the “crime” of demanding freedom.

I didn’t ask these people to go to the streets and risk their lives believing help is on the way.
You did.

So this is the help they were promised: not targeting infrastructure but targeting the butchers who are executing them.

And to the UN Secretary-General, the Prime Minister of Spain, @sanche

Shahin Vahedparast was the other protester who was executed by hanging in Iran today. 
He was 31 years old.
And that’s almost all we know about him.

Because the internet was cut by the regime and sources tell us that his family was threatened into silence.
You get hanged for the crime of protesting with empty hand in 21st century and some still call this regime a normal government. 
Many more are waiting to be executed for the same reason.

Please, don’t get used to this. Don’t scroll past it l

This morning the Islamic regime in Iran killed two more protester by hanging.

Look at his face. This is one of them; Mohammadamin Biglari. Only 19. A caregiver. A young man trying to hold his world together after losing his mother, while taking care of his sick father.

Right now, Iranians are living under bombs and fear.
And still, the regime finds the time, to take prisoners out of their cells, one by one, and execute them to send a message to the rest of the population:

We are going to send Iran back to the Stone Age?

President @realDonaldTrump! Stop targeting ordinary Iranians and Iran’s infrastructure, the Islamic regime’s officials you call “less radical leaders” in Iran, the ones you are willing to negotiate with are exactly the ones with a Stone Age mindset. 

President Obama once called them “moderates” and tried to negotiate with them.
You are making the same mistake by calling them “ reasonable”

This is the right move because she was openly promoting IRGC to designated terrorist organization on her social media.

I want to directly address Secretary Marco Rubio and the U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security:

Do not put Iranian students and professionals at risk. Because Many Iranians in the United States are not part of this regime, they have fled it.
They came legally, respect the law, and contribute to this country.

Do not treat them as the threat they escaped.


Masih Alinejad 🏳️ (@Al

The U.S. State Department announced the detention of Qasem Soleimani’s relative and her daughter.

According to this report, Hamidah Soleimani Afshar and her daughter are currently in U.S. immigration custody.

Until recently, they were living in the United States on green cards, enjoying the safety and freedoms denied to millions of Iranians.

First, Narges Mohammadi, a Nobel Peace Prize winner, nearly suffers a heart attack in prison, denied proper medical care. 
Now, Nasrin Sotoudeh, a lawyer and another human rights defender is arrested in Iran.

When a regime shows no mercy to those who speak the language of peace,
be certain, it will never understand the language of diplomacy.

I call on the international community, especially women leaders, to stand up against a regime that wages war on peaceful voices.
#DigitalBlackout

In the middle of war, in Iran, at dawn, at the call to prayer, they took a 68-year-old architect from his cell to the gallows and executed him.

This is how they rule Iran: they cut the internet. They torture political prisoners to do false confessions. They air it on state TV. They execute them. Then they announce it on state media.

We Iranians are living in horror and it is beyond sad that international media barely talks about it. I believe this silence will embolden the regime to turn mass

His mother begged the free world to help save her son’s life. No one listened.
This morning, the barbaric regime executed Vahid Bani-Amerian by hanging in Iran. 

They shuts down the internet to hide its crimes, then uses that same internet to broadcast death.

Imagine waking up to state media announcing, one by one,
that the protesters are being hanged.

Vahid was tortured. Broken. Forced into a false confession on TV. And then they killed him.

Heartbroken 💔
Matin Khademi, a young Iranian student in Turin, Italy, ended his own life under the unbearable psychological pressure of the regime’s massacre of the Iranian people. Iranians living in Turin held his funeral without his family. Because of the internet blackout, his family couldn’t even see pictures of their son’s burial in another country. The crimes of this regime will be forever recorded in history. 💔✌🏻

#Iran 
#DigitalBlackOutIran‌

Remember: Iranian schoolgirls were poisoned for removing forced hijab.
Their mothers demanded answers and were beaten.  

At the same time, European officials went to Tehran, complied with hijab, and legitimized the same system.

Masih Alinejad 🏳️ (@AlinejadMasih)

To those European leaders who seem very passionate about upholding international law:

Watch this video and listen carefully to my address at St. Paul’s Church, the cradle of German democracy.

Especially you, Mr. President Steinmeier of Germany; you, Prime Minister of Spain, @sanchezcastejon; and UK Prime Minister @Keir_Starmer.

Look at these two screenshots.
From 421 million views… to silence. This is what a #DigitalBlackOut looks like.

from protests, from the streets, from their daily struggles.

They were the voice of a nation but now… silence. Because, Iran’s internet has been almost completely shut down connectivity dropped to nearly zero, cutting millions off from the world. 90 million people pushed into darkness.
